passages.note: Support for reauthorizing the Prop 30/55 school-dedicated tax extends existing revenue for schools; it shows the tax-for-schools side but not a significant funding increase above costs, so it does not separate rung 1 from the others.
Forum answers on housing and homelessness; nothing on school funding levels or taxes for schools.

rows.reasoning: Becerra said the Prop 55/Prop 30 extension, "money dedicated to our schools", "should be, reauthorized by the voters", which leans toward taxes for schools but extends an existing tax rather than showing a significant increase above costs, so it does not establish "Raise taxes to significantly increase school funding" or any other single rung.

quotes.text: I think there will be an initiative on the ballot that tries to really extend what we passed, about ten years ago, prop 55, prop 30, which was money dedicated to our schools. With so many going to health care, I think that's an initiative that should be, reauthorized by the voters.
